movelist.name: Crunch
movelist.effect: Crunch lowers the target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+

movelist.name: Discharge
movelist.effect: Discharge Paralyzes all legal targets on 15+.

movelist.name: Acid
movelist.effect: Acid lowers the target’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage on 18+.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.effect: The Pokémon resists Ground-Type Moves one step further, and gains a Levitate Speed of 4, or has existing Levitate Speeds increased by +2. Defensive.

abilities.name: Sequence
abilities.trigger: The user uses an Electric Attack
abilities.effect: For every Electric-Type Pokémon adjacent to the user, the triggering Attack deals an additional +3 Damage.

abilities.name: Lightning Rod
abilities.trigger: A ranged Electric Type Move is used within 10
abilities.effect: The Move is turned into a 1-Target Move and is re-directed at the user without fail, and cannot miss. This negates Lock-On or Mind Reader.  The user’s Special Attack is then raised by +1 Combat Stage.
